name: net2net-unifi-radius
description: Net2Net UniFi RADIUS. Local users, VLAN profiles, PEAP/MSCHAPv2 and accounting. Set a unique administrator password of at least 12 characters before first start. For a dedicated LAN IP, select your custom br0 network and assign an unused address.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, encryption key, certificates and accounting logs

ports.name: Web portal
ports.description: Portal host port when using bridge networking; dedicated br0 uses port 8080 directly

variables.name: Initial administrator password
variables.description: Required on first start. Choose a unique password with at least 12 characters. Initializes an empty database only.

variables.name: RADIUS certificate DNS name
variables.description: Set before first start. Clients validate this name against the generated server certificate.
